tasks.title: Conversation #102
tasks.transcript:
Man: So they updated the meeting agenda for tomorrow.
Woman: Yes, I saw the email. Apparently the guest speaker from the product strategy team had to cancel last minute.
Man: Really? That's too bad. She was going to present the new timeline for the fourth quarter software release. That's important information.
Woman: Definitely. But they've replaced her with someone from the marketing team. He's going to walk us through the upcoming social media campaign for the mobile app launch.
Man: That's useful too. I hope it covers our television ads too. That concerns me more directly.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

options.D: Some new members of a work team

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者主要在讨论什么？ 定位原文：Man: So they updated the meeting agenda for tomorrow. / Woman: Apparently the guest speaker ... had to cancel ... they've replaced her with someone from the marketing team. 选项分析： A. A software update 软件更新。对话中提到软件发布的时间线，但这不是讨论的核心，所以A选项错误。 B. An email promotion 邮件推广活动。对话中提到邮件（saw the email）但讨论的是邮件内容（会议议程变更），而非邮件推广，所以B选项错误。 C. Some changes to a presentation 演示内容的变更。两人主要在讨论原定演讲者取消、更换为市场部同事以及新演讲内容（社交媒体推广活动），所以C选项正确。 D. Some new members of a work team 工作团队的新成员。对话中未提及新成员加入团队，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What department of the company does the man most likely work in?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：男士最有可能在公司的哪个部门工作？ 定位原文：Man: I hope it covers our television ads too. That concerns me more directly. 选项分析： A. Advertising 广告部。男士提到“television ads”（电视广告）且说这与他“更直接相关”，说明他很可能在广告/宣传部门工作，所以A选项正确。 B. Software Development 软件开发部。对话中原演讲者来自“product strategy team”并讲软件发布时间线，但这并非男士的部门，他的关注点在广告，所以B选项错误。 C. Human Resources 人力资源部。对话中未提及招聘、培训等人力资源相关内容，所以C选项错误。 D. Project Planning 项目规划部。虽然时间线属于项目规划相关内容，但男士明确表示电视广告与自己更直接相关，因此广告部门更合理，所以D选项错误。
